assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. IMAGE-ONLY fashion item illustration for an app, no page design. Setting: dystopian retrofuturist city circa 2045. Mature detailed drawn CEL SHADING, thin varied ink line, broad painted shadow planes and reflected light, convincing material texture and functional seams, fasteners and folds. Main object sharply described, surrounding shop softer and lower contrast. Opaque 3:2 landscape, complete focal object comfortably framed. No text, letters, numbers, logos, badges, labels, banners, titles, watermark or UI anywhere. No photorealism, glossy 3D, heavy icon outline, fantasy, magic, toy forms, gratuitous wear or visual noise. No human model; use neutral store display props only. A complete pair of adult-sized trousers, both legs fully visible, displayed on a neutral waist-down mannequin with simple feet supports. No top or jacket included. Adapt cut and materials to the fashion direction. Fashion direction: Comfortable athletic leisurewear: graphite, blue and small lime accents, flexible breathable technical fabric, streamlined functional panels and light hardware. Backdrop: an urban sports outfitter in clear daylight.
